summary: xAI released an Agent Dashboard for Grok Build that lets developers monitor, reply to, and dispatch multiple parallel coding-agent sessions from a single CLI or in-session view.

mechanisms.reason: The dashboard is built specifically to let a single developer run and manage many autonomous coding agent sessions in parallel, supporting agent-executed work at scale, though no adoption or scale figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Manage many coding sessions at once. See what each is doing, reply to the ones that need you, and dispatch new work.

practices.reason: The dashboard describes a concrete, usable pattern for managing parallel agent sessions, subagent roll-up, and turn-based queuing that a team could adopt directly for orchestrating coding agents.
practices.quote: bagents roll up under the session that launched them, so the list shows the work you dispatched, not the fan-out beneath it. P

practices.reason: Adding the dashboard requires installing a new CLI and adopting new session-management commands into a team's workflow.
practices.quote: e Agent Dashboard ships with Grok Build. Install it with a single command, then run grok dashboard , or /dashboard from any session you already have open. $
